verses.sanskrit: कुन्त्युवाच। अर्जुनं केशव ब्रूयास्त्वयि जाते स्म सूतके। उपोपविष्टा नारीभिराश्रमे परिवारिता ॥१॥
verses.english: Kunti said OKeshava, speak this to Arjuna “At the time of your birth when I was seated: in the lying-in-room in the asylum surrounded by females,

verses.sanskrit: अथान्तरिक्षे वागासीद्दिव्यरूपा मनोरमा। सहस्त्राक्षसमः कुन्ति भविष्यत्येष ते सुतः ॥२॥
verses.english: There was heard a voice in the sky which seemed to be celestial and which pleased the heart; it said: 0 Kunti, this son of yours will be equal to him of a thousand eyes.

verses.sanskrit: एष जेष्यति सङ्ग्रामे कुरुन् सर्वान् समागतान्। भीमसेनद्वितीयश्च लोकमुद्वर्तयिष्यति ॥३॥
verses.english: He will conquer in fight all the Kurus assembled together and with Bhimasena as his second will grind his enemies.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रस्ते पृथिवीं जेता यशश्चास्य दिवं स्पृशेत्। हत्या कुरूंश्च सङ्ग्रामे वासुदेवसहायवान् ॥४॥
verses.english: Your son will be the subjugator of the world and his fame will touch the heavens; having slain the Kurus in battle with the assistance of Vasudeva,

verses.sanskrit: पित्र्यमंशं प्रनष्टं च पुनरप्युद्धरिष्यति। भ्रातृभिः सहितः श्रीमांस्त्रीन् मेधानाहरिष्यति ॥५॥
verses.english: He will regain the paternal share of the kingdom which shall have been lost; and along with his brothers this one endued with prosperity will perform perform three sacrificial ceremonies.

verses.sanskrit: स सत्यसन्धो बीभत्सुः सव्यसाची यथाऽच्युत। तथा त्वमेव जानासि बलवन्तं दुरासदम् ॥६॥
verses.english: You know how devoted to truth is Vibhatsu, how mighty is Savyasachin of unimpairing glory and how hard it is to resist him.

verses.sanskrit: तथा तदस्तु दाशार्ह यथा वागभ्यभाषत। धर्मश्चेदस्ति वार्ष्णेय तथा सत्यं भविष्यति ॥७॥
verses.english: Let it therefore be, Oscion of the Dasharha race, as that voice said; if there is virtue then, O scion of the Vrishni race, will it be true.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं चापि तत्तथा कृष्ण सर्वं सम्पादयिष्यसि। नाहं तदभ्यसूयामि यथा वागभ्यभाषत ॥८॥
verses.english: You too, O Krishna, will do all that has been said by that voice, I do not doubt the truth of what the voice has said.

verses.sanskrit: नमो धर्माय महते धर्मो धारयति प्रजाः। एतद्धनञ्जयो वाच्यो नित्योद्युक्तो वृकोदरः ॥९॥
verses.english: I do not doubt the eventual justification of that foreboding. I bow to Dharma and to the creator and to Krishna who is ever great. Creatures are supported by Dharma (Virtue).

verses.sanskrit: यदर्थं क्षत्रिया सूते तस्य कालोऽयमागतः। न हि वैरं समासाद्य सीदन्ति पुरुषर्षभाः ॥१०॥
verses.english: I bow down to the great Dharma for it is Dharma that sustains the living creatures. Speak this to Dhananjaya; and Vrikodara who is ever ready for action should also thus be spoken to the object for which a Kshatriya lady brings forth a child is come; best of men do not grieve when they meet with an enemy.

verses.sanskrit: विदिता ते सदा बुद्धिर्भीमस्य न स शाम्यति। यावदन्तं न कुरुते शत्रूणां शत्रुकर्शन ॥११॥
verses.english: It is known to you what the bent of Bhima's mind is; he is not to be calmed down till he has not made an end of his enemies, O you chastiser of foes.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वधर्मविशेषज्ञां स्नुषां पाण्डोर्महात्मनः। ब्रूया माधव कल्याणीं कृष्ण कृष्णां यशस्विनीम् ॥१२॥
verses.english: O Madhava, O Krishna, tell that blessed lady of renown-the daughter-in-law of the great-souled Pandu, who is especially conversant with all virtues.

verses.sanskrit: युक्तमेतन्महाभागे कुले जाते यशस्विनि। यन्मे पुत्रेषु सर्वेषु यथावत्वमवर्तिथाः ॥१३॥
verses.english: O you endued with great qualities, O you born in a high family, O you of renown, the conduct you adopt towards my sons of befitting for and worthy of yourself.

verses.sanskrit: विक्रमाधिगता ह्यर्थाः क्षत्रधर्मेण जीवतः। मनो मनुष्यस्य सदा प्रीणन्ति पुरुषोत्तम ॥१५॥
verses.english: Objects gained by the exercise of prowess always please the heart of a man following the duties of a Kshatriya.

verses.sanskrit: यच्च वः प्रेक्षमाणानां सर्वधर्मोपचायिनाम्। पाञ्चाली परुषाण्युक्ता को नु तत् क्षन्तुमर्हति ॥१६॥
verses.english: Engaged in your own duties before your very presence the princess of Panchala following every virtue was spoken to harshly-it is not proper for you to forgive that insult.

verses.sanskrit: न राज्यहरणं दुःखं द्यूते चापि पराजयः। प्रव्राजनं सुतानां वा न मे तद्दुःखकारणम् ॥१७॥
verses.english: The loss of the kingdom was not so painful to me on the defeat at dice nor even the exile of my sons was so painful to me,

verses.sanskrit: यत्र सा बृहती श्यामा सभायां रुदती तदा। अश्रौषीत् परुषा वाचस्तन्मे दुःखतरं महत् ॥१८॥
verses.english: As the weeping of the noble lady Krishna in the assembly at that time who was made to hear very harsh words; this was the source of a pain greater to me than all this.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीधर्मिणी वरारोहा क्षत्रधर्मरता सदा। नाध्यगच्छत्तदा नाथं कृष्णा नाथवती सती ॥१९॥
verses.english: Krishna, though her husbands were living, was at that time without the protection of a lord-that lady of beautiful hips with the modesty proper to a lay and ever attached to the virtue of a Kshatriya princess.

verses.sanskrit: तं वै ब्रूहि महाबाहो सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम्। अर्जुनं पुरुषव्याघ्रं द्रौपद्याः पदवीं चर ॥२०॥
verses.english: O you of long arms, speak to him who is the foremost of all wielders of arms, to Arjuna, that best among men “Follow the path indicated by Draupadi.”

verses.sanskrit: विदितं हि तवात्यन्तं क्रुद्धाविव यमान्तकौ। भीमार्जुनौ नयेतां हि देवानपि परां गतिम् ॥२१॥
verses.english: It is known to you that the two, Bhima and Arjuna when excited with wrath would even lead the very gods to obtain eternal salvation.
verses.bhavadeepa: पदवीं चर मार्गमनुसर शत्रुस्त्रीणां वैधव्यार्थं यतस्वेत्यर्थः ॥२०॥

verses.sanskrit: तयोश्चैतदवज्ञानं यत्सा कृष्णा सभागता। दुःशासनश्च यद्भीमं कटुकान्यभ्यभाषत ॥२२॥
verses.english: And Dushasana and Karna spoke harsh and insulting words. Duryodhana has insulted the spirited Bhimasena.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यतां कुरुवीराणां तच्च संस्मारयेः पुनः। पाण्डवान् कुशलं पृच्छेः सपुत्रान् कृष्णया सह ॥२३॥
verses.english: Offered within the range of the sight of the heroes among the Kurus. Remember that and ask about the health of the Pandavas and of Krishna with her sons.

verses.sanskrit: माद्रीपुत्रौ च वक्तव्यौ क्षत्रधर्मरतावुभौ। विक्रमेणार्जितान् भोगान् वृणीतं जीवितादपि ॥२४॥
verses.english: The two sons Madri, both of whom observe the duties of a Kshatriya, should also be thus spoken to Enjoyment earned by the exercise of prowess should be preferred to life itself.

verses.sanskrit: मां च कुशलिनीं ब्रूयास्तेषु भूयो जनार्दन। अरिष्टं गच्छ पन्थानं पुत्रान् मे प्रतिपालय ॥२४॥
verses.english: The two sons Madri, both of whom observe the duties of a Kshatriya, should also be thus spoken to Enjoyment earned by the exercise of prowess should be preferred to life itself.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              अभिवाद्याथ तां कृष्णः कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्। निश्चक्राम महाबाहुः सिंहखेलगतिस्ततः ॥२५॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Krishna, with long arms, then having saluted her and having gone round her, departed from there with the gait of a sportive lion.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विसर्जयामास भीष्मादीन् कुरुपुङ्गवान्। आरोप्याथ रथे कर्णं प्रायात् सात्यकिना सह ॥२६॥
verses.english: Then he sent away those best among the Kuru race Bhishma and others and getting up on the chariot he departed with Satyaki.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रयाते दाशार्हे कुरवः संगता मिथः। जजल्पुर्महदाश्चर्यं केशवे परमाद्भुतम् ॥२७॥
verses.english: The scion of the Dasharha race having departed, the Kurus assembled together and conversed on the greatly wonderful thing which had happened in connection with Krishna.

verses.sanskrit: प्रमूढा पृथियी सर्वा मृत्युपाशवशीकृता। दुर्योधनस्य बालिश्यान्नैतदस्तीति चाब्रुवन् ॥२८॥
verses.english: The entire earth, having been deprived of senses, has been brought under the influence of death. In consequence of folly this has already ceased to exist-so did they say.

verses.sanskrit: ततो निर्याय नगरात् प्रययौ पुरुषोत्तमः। मन्त्रयामास च तदा कर्णेन सुचिरं सह ॥२९॥
verses.english: Having gone out of the town that best among men departed and began to consult Karna for some time.

verses.sanskrit: विसर्जयित्वा राधेयं सर्वयादवनन्दनः। ततो जवेन महता तूर्णमश्वानचोदयत् ॥३०॥
verses.english: And having dismissed the son of Radha, that delighter of all the Yadavas soon urged his horses to great speed.

verses.sanskrit: ते पिबन्त इवाकाशं दारुकेण प्रचोदिताः। हया जग्मुर्महावेगा मनोमारुतरंहसः ॥३१॥
verses.english: The horses being urged by Daruka went along with the speed of a wink, drinking as it were the sky.

verses.sanskrit: ते व्यतीत्य महाध्वानं क्षिप्रं श्येना इवाशुगाः। उचैर्जग्मुरुपप्लव्यं शार्ङ्गधन्वानमावहन् ॥३२॥
verses.english: Having traversed a long way speedily like quick-coursing hawks the horses reached Upaplavya, bearing the wielders of the Shranga bow.
